title: Shih-te
description: This is one of the older trees in my collection. It was repotted in 2023 and allowed to regain its vigor. Three years later, it is ready to be styled.

title: I hardly know Yew
description: This is a tree I've had since 2017. I acquired it at a nursery that decided to no longer carry shrubs and bought it on sale. This is the first tree I ever entered in a show, the Virginia Bonsai Society Annual Show at the Norfolk Botanical Garden, April 2026.

title: Han Shan
description: I acquired this tree in 2018 and in 2023 took it to a Jenifer Price workshop sponsored by the Virginia Bonsai Society.  Jenifer observed that the tree was weak and in desperate need of re-potting. She advised that I should wait at least two years, maybe three, before thinking about styling. It was her opinion that the tree is roughly 80 year old. It appears that the tree has become more healthy and vigorous and I look forward to perhaps returning with it when she conducts another session for the club.
